name: How long does the window frame replacement process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the window frame replacement process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window frame replacement project depends on several factors, including the number of windows, their size, the type of windows being installed, and the complexity of the installation. For a typical home, replacing a few windows might take a day or two. A full house replacement could take several days to over a week. The process includes removing old frames, preparing the openings, installing new frames and windows, and finishing work like sealing and trim. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window frame replacement duration varies by project size and complexity, ranging from a day for a few windows to over a week for a full house replacement.
